title: Thermalright Peerless Assassin 120 CPU Air Cooler $36.23 + Delivery ($0 with Prime/$59 Spend) @ suomole via Amazon AU
body:
Deal: Thermalright Peerless Assassin 120 CPU Air Cooler $36.23 + Delivery ($0 with Prime/$59 Spend) @ suomole via Amazon AU

[ATangk] Prices being down because there’s a huge slowdown in pc’s being built due to the extreme memory prices.
Also, good first deal but you need to put the store in the title. In this case since it’s Amazon, and price doesn’t go to the free shipping threshold, add this:
+ Delivery ($0 Prime/$59 Spend) @ suomole via Amazon AU
[maverickjohn] Is there a pa that's 7 pipes. I thought that was the phantom spirit model
[J0hn] No, only phantom spirit has it. for couple more dollars, definitely PS
[maverickjohn] I was trying to work out what PE was, I think it was an accidental typo for PS. But yeah phantom spirit at $48 is better but PA is still no slouch.
The decision is harder for PS vs royal pretor
[J0hn] @maverickjohn: Yea not too sure about that
[obit11] I have had the PS120SE for 2-3 years, good cooler.
[maverickjohn] That's the model up from this.
I have the pa120se and it keeps my undervolted 13600kf in check
[netsev] I've bought 3 of these and on 2 of them the front fan developed a slicing sound, apparently it's a common issue with the fans on these due to inferior sleeves in the fans, I had to replace the fans with arctic fans the noise was unbearable. Saying that the one working well is still going strong 3yrs on.
[maverickjohn] https://amzn.asia/d/04OCWg7S
Their flagship cooler also decently priced
[Apostle0748] Good price.
There is one higher though - Royal Pretor Ultra 130. If I remember correctly, I got mine for around $88 AUD via AliExpress… $30 price bump is probably not worth it.
[back22010] I bought last year from this buyer, one screw was rusted, thy said it is normal.
[Budju] that not so normal. FWIW I got one from these guys it was fine.
[Camw] Sorry to hear, I also bought from this seller with no problems.
[vanyellow] damn good price, i thought sub $50 was good value..
this is a no brainer purchase for a good cpu cooler!
[Dienk] Is this one better?
https://amzn.asia/d/03w4Y70F
[ATangk] May be overkill depending on your use case, and need to make sure something this big can fit inside your case as well.
[kml22] Awesome cooler, beats all other coolers that cost twice or 3 time the price.
[4foxache] Very quiet fans too that respond well to fan curve tuning even at full speed I don't find them particularly annoying like the acoustics of some fans.
Works well on my 5800X running CO -15
[MrZ] How does this compare to "Be Quiet!" coolers?
[ilikegengar] No but a quarter of the price. Can buy this and slap a noctua fan on it
[jonathonsunshine] Two left in stock if anyone keen, I figure that's not enough to mark as back in stock though
